caption: The video showcases a polished metallic assembly resting on a black rectangular slab against a plain white backdrop. A large sphere crowns a tall central column, while shorter posts topped with small spheres rise from a stepped lattice of cube blocks. A hexagonal nut is visible at the column's foot. The assembly rotates about a vertical axis throughout the excerpt, so the posts, cubes, and nut present shifting faces and the spheres' reflections reorient. At the top of the frame, a hand holds a thin wooden stick, its lower end contacting the base. The stick sweeps from the left edge of the structure across the front toward the right side while the sculpture turns. The hand and stick leave the frame, but the rotation continues without them. The black slab and white background remain fixed, emphasizing the object's changing orientation rather than a scene relocation.
